title: polygala oppositifolia var. nummularia
intro: Polygala oppositifolia var. nummularia, commonly known as Korean milk vetch, is a plant species belonging to the Polygalaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean milk vetch are attributed to its ability to tonify and nourish the body, particularly the kidneys and spleen, and to its anti-aging effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
